Know before you go

GOOD QUESTIONS.
CLEAR ANSWERS.

Everything you need for a confident visit to Tom’s.

Is the automatic wash really touchless?

Yes. The automatic bay uses water pressure and wash chemistry without brushes or cloth contacting your vehicle. The self-serve bays are a separate, hands-on option.

Do I need an appointment?

No appointment is needed for the automatic or self-serve wash. Visit any time: Tom’s is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

Can I clean the inside of my car?

Yes. Self-service vacuums and interior-care equipment are available, including shampoo and spot-removal options. These are tools you use yourself; staffed interior detailing is not advertised.

What is the ceramic protection in Ultimate?

Ultimate includes Mirror Carnauba Ceramic Protection as part of the automatic wash. It is a wash-applied treatment, not a professionally installed, multi-year ceramic coating.

Do you take credit cards?

The automatic and self-serve bays have card readers, according to the business’s supplied owner updates. Payment options may differ at the vacuums and vending equipment; check the machine before starting.

Is touchless washing suitable for my vehicle?

Check your vehicle owner’s manual and any coating, wrap or paint-protection-film care instructions before washing. Follow all posted vehicle-clearance and entry instructions at the bay. Touchless does not mean every finish or vehicle is suitable.

Are the vacuums free?

Vacuums are available on site. We do not advertise them as free; check the current price on the machine.

How does the Wash Club work?

Tom’s advertises loyalty rewards, special pricing and birthday washes through its Wash Club. Visit the linked club portal for current terms. It is not described here as an unlimited monthly subscription.

What if I have a problem with my wash?

Call 484-948-1243 or email info@tomscarwash.com with the date, approximate time and the bay or machine involved. The team can help review what happened.

Where is Tom’s Car Wash?

Find us at 750 Walnut Street, Royersford, PA 19468. Open 24/7 for touchless automatic and self-serve washing.
